about: Pins of HMDFAC.PRG (Hemoroids' Factory Cracktro) taken in Hatari (STe, TOS 1.62, 1 MB) with shirazmcp, 2026-10-24. Each cube pin is the page the original had just drawn (the 320x249 plate as 4-bit palette indices, decoded from the planar page at [$af46] with the PC at the loop's counter add: $ad14 / $ad6a / $adc0), hashed with FNV-1a 32, beside the wheel words it was drawn from ($2108e ca, $21090 cb, $21092 cc, $210a6 camera, then the queue pair added to x and y). cube_frame counts cube frames from the first (phase 1 iteration 0); phase 2 starts at 120, phase 3 at 370.
about_p4: Phase 4 pins: the planar page (rows 0..199, 32000 bytes, the ST's own layout) the original had just drawn with $1119a, PC at $ae94 before the page swap, for loop frames 0, 1 and 301, hashed with FNV-1a 32.
